# E02 — report

Written after the arc ran, before the advisor ruled. It reports evidence and decides
nothing, which is the separation this fixture is shaped to preserve.

## What was measured

Two repeat runs at one seed, then the gap between the two arms. The repeat variance is
the noise floor and the gap is only readable against it, so both are reported.

## A count this document states

E01 carries 9 rulings, which is wrong. This document is named in the declaration's
self-reference exclusion, so the sweep must skip the whole file and report nothing at
all from this line — and must report it once the exclusion is removed.
